faq.q_merge: How do I merge PDFs online without uploading them?
faq.a_merge: Use the Merge PDF tool in the Lab: pick the files, reorder them and download the single PDF. Files are processed in your browser, with no sign-up and no upload to a server.
faq.q_compress: How do I reduce a PDF's size to send it by email?
faq.a_compress: With Compress PDF you pick one of three levels and see right away how much space you save, so the file fits in an email or a form. The PDF is processed in your browser and is not uploaded.
faq.q_heic: How do I convert iPhone HEIC photos to JPG?
faq.a_heic: Drop your photos into the HEIC to JPG tool: they convert in your browser, in batches too, and download one by one or as a single ZIP. No sign-up needed.
faq.q_privacy: Are the tools free? Are my files safe?
faq.a_privacy: They are free and need no sign-up. Merge, compress, sign, photo and QR code tools run in your browser. OCR and the AI tools send the document to the server to process it, so avoid confidential files with those.

pdf_search.faq_a1: It searches Internet Archive, Project Gutenberg, arXiv and PubMed Central at the same time and only shows results with an actually available PDF, with a direct in-browser preview before downloading.
pdf_search.faq_q2: Is it legal to download these PDFs?
pdf_search.faq_a2: Yes. Every indexed source only publishes public-domain or open-access material: books with expired copyright, scientific papers and freely licensed articles. No pirated content.
pdf_search.faq_q3: What sources does this copyright-free PDF search cover?
pdf_search.faq_a3: Internet Archive and Project Gutenberg for public-domain books and classics, arXiv and PubMed Central for scientific papers and open-access academic articles.
pdf_search.faq_q4: Can I search for public-domain PDF books in other languages?
pdf_search.faq_a4: Yes, Internet Archive includes many public-domain scans in dozens of languages, alongside Project Gutenberg's mostly English-language catalog.
pdf_search.faq_q5: Why don't some results have a preview?
pdf_search.faq_a5: Some sources (e.g. PubMed Central) block direct page embedding for technical reasons on their server — in that case, downloading is still available.
pdf_search.faq_q6: Is the PDF search engine free?
pdf_search.faq_a6: Yes, completely free, no registration and no usage limits, aside from a technical anti-abuse cap of 20 searches per minute.

ocr.about: This OCR (optical character recognition) tool turns photos, images and scanned PDFs into text you can select, copy and edit. Use it to recover the text from a photographed receipt, a book page, a scanned document or a screenshot, without retyping it by hand.
steps: Drag your images or PDF into the upload area, or click it to choose them.
Select the language of the text: recognition is far more accurate when the language is right.
Start the recognition: for each page you see the extracted text and, when confidence is low, a warning.
Copy the text, send it to another Lab tool or save it to your Library.
ocr.privacy: Images are sent to our server only for recognition and are processed in memory, without being stored as an archive. You do not need to create an account.
ocr.limits: You can upload up to 30 files or pages at a time; each image can be up to 15 MB and the first 20 pages of each PDF are read. The available languages are Italian, English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese and Albanian. Quality depends on the photo: crooked, blurry or dim text reduces accuracy.

faq.q: Does OCR also work on PDFs?
faq.a: Yes. If the PDF is a scan, meaning its pages are images, the tool reads them and extracts the text. If the PDF already contains selectable text you usually do not need OCR.

faq.q: Which languages does it recognise?
faq.a: Italian, English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese and Albanian. Choose the language before starting: with the right one the result is much more accurate.

faq.q: Why does the extracted text contain mistakes?
faq.a: OCR makes errors when the image is blurry, tilted, low in contrast or uses unusual characters. Try taking the photo again with more light, keeping the sheet straight, and check you picked the correct language.

faq.q: Do I need to sign up or pay?
faq.a: No, the tool is free and needs no account. There is only a limit on requests over a short period, to prevent abuse: if you hit it, wait a moment and try again.

scanner.about: The scanner turns the camera of your phone or computer into a document scanner: you shoot the pages, crop them, apply a filter to improve legibility and combine them into a single PDF to download. It is handy when you have no scanner at hand and need a contract, a receipt or a form as a PDF.
steps: Start the camera and frame the page, or upload an image you already have.
Drag on the image to crop the edges of the sheet and remove the background.
Repeat for each page; if a page came out badly you can delete it.
Export the PDF and download it; if you need the text, use OCR as well.
scanner.privacy: Shooting, cropping and filters happen in your browser: images do not leave your device until you choose otherwise. Only if you use OCR or export the PDF are the pages sent to our server, for the time needed to process them.
scanner.limits: PNG, JPG and WEBP images are accepted, up to 20 MB each and up to 20 pages per document. Captured pages are not saved: if you reload or close the tab you lose them, so download the PDF before leaving. The camera needs a secure connection (HTTPS) and your permission.

faq.q: Does it work from a phone?
faq.a: Yes, it is designed for smartphones too: the browser asks your permission to use the camera. If it is not available you can upload photos you have already taken.

faq.q: Can I put several pages in one PDF?
faq.a: Yes, up to 20 pages: each captured page is added to the document, which you export as a single PDF at the end.

faq.q: How do I get text I can copy?
faq.a: Use the scanner's OCR function, or send the pages to the Lab's OCR tool: it recognises the text and makes it selectable and copyable.

faq.q: Are my photos stored?
faq.a: No: captured pages stay in your browser and disappear if you reload the page. They reach the server only if you choose OCR or PDF export.

pdf_editor.about: The online PDF editor lets you merge several PDFs into one, split a document, rotate or delete single pages, change the page order and add a text watermark. Everything happens in your browser: it is the most convenient way to fix a PDF without installing software and without sending the file to an outside service.
steps: Drag one or more PDFs into the upload area: if you pick more than one they are placed in sequence.
In the page preview, drag to reorder pages, rotate crooked ones or delete the ones you do not need.
If needed, type a watermark text, or enter a page range to split the document.
Export the PDF and download it.
pdf_editor.privacy: Files are processed entirely in your browser: they are not uploaded to any server. You can therefore work on contracts, ID documents or invoices without sharing them with third parties.
pdf_editor.limits: Changes are not saved: if you reload or close the tab you lose them, so download the result before leaving. A password-protected or very large PDF may not open or may slow down the browser, because your device does the work. The watermark is text only.

faq.q: How do I merge two PDFs?
faq.a: Upload both files together: they appear in sequence and you can reorder the pages by dragging them. Then export the result as a single PDF.

faq.q: Are my PDFs uploaded online?
faq.a: No. Processing happens in the browser, so the files stay on your device.

faq.q: Can I extract only some pages?
faq.a: Yes: delete the pages you do not need, or use the page range to split the document, then export.

faq.q: Can I edit the text inside a PDF?
faq.a: No, this tool works on pages (merge, split, rotate, delete, watermark), not on the content. To edit the text you can convert the PDF to Word with the file converter.

viewer.about: The online PDF viewer opens a document in your browser with zoom, text search, page thumbnails and a highlighter. Use it to read and consult a PDF without installing a program and without uploading it anywhere, even from a phone.
steps: Drag the PDF into the upload area or choose the file from your device.
Move between pages with the thumbnails and use zoom to enlarge or reduce.
Search for a word: the tool highlights the matches in the text.
Turn on the highlighter and drag over the text to mark important passages.
viewer.privacy: The document is read entirely in your browser and is never uploaded: you can safely consult confidential files too.
viewer.limits: Search only works if the PDF contains selectable text. If it is a scan, meaning the pages are images, the tool warns you: in that case extract the text first with the OCR tool. Very large files may take longer on older devices.

faq.q: Why does search find nothing in my PDF?
faq.a: The PDF is probably a scan: its pages are images and contain no searchable text. Send the file to the OCR tool to extract the text, then search.

faq.q: Is the file uploaded to a server?
faq.a: No. The PDF is opened and read by your browser, so it stays on your device.

faq.q: Can I highlight and annotate the text?
faq.a: Yes: turn on the highlighter and drag over the text to mark it.

faq.q: Does it work on a smartphone?
faq.a: Yes, the viewer adapts to a phone screen; with very large documents opening can be slower.

editor.about: The online document editor lets you write and format text right in your browser and export it as PDF, DOCX (Word) or HTML. It is useful when you need to prepare a letter, meeting minutes or a report quickly without opening Word, or when you need to turn text into a format that is easy to share.
steps: Write or paste your text and format it with the toolbar: headings, lists, bold and italic.
If you already have a document you can import it and keep working on it.
Choose the export format: PDF, DOCX or HTML.
Download the resulting file.
editor.privacy: While you write, the text stays in your browser. When you export to PDF or DOCX the content is sent to our server only to generate the file.
editor.limits: Imported documents can be up to 50 MB. Exporting needs an active connection. Export the document before closing the tab so you do not lose your work.

faq.q: Which formats can I export to?
faq.a: PDF, DOCX (compatible with Word) and HTML.

faq.q: Can I start from a document I already have?
faq.a: Yes, you can import a document, up to 50 MB, and keep editing it in the editor.

faq.q: Do I need to install anything or create an account?
faq.a: No: it works in the browser, even on a phone, and needs no account.

faq.q: Is my text sent to a server?
faq.a: Only when you export to PDF or DOCX: at that moment the server needs the content to create the file.

convert.about: The online file converter turns documents and images from one format into another: between PDF, Word (DOCX), text, HTML and Markdown, but also images to WebP for the web and CSV or JSON to PDF reports, plus merging several PDFs into one. Pick the conversion you need, upload the file and download the result.
steps: Search or pick the conversion you need from the list, for example PDF → DOCX.
Drag the file into the upload area or choose it from your device.
Start the conversion and wait a few seconds.
When it finishes, the download starts automatically.
convert.privacy: To convert the file it is sent to our server, which processes it and returns the result. Files are used only to run the conversion you requested.
convert.limits: Each file can be up to 50 MB; for conversions that combine several files, such as merging PDFs, you can select up to 20. A PDF with very complex tables or layouts may lose some formatting when converted to Word. A scanned PDF does not become editable text: use OCR first.

faq.q: How do I convert a PDF to Word without losing formatting?
faq.a: Choose the PDF → DOCX conversion. PDFs with selectable text usually keep headings, paragraphs and lists; very elaborate layouts may need small touch-ups after conversion. The article linked below has the full guide.

faq.q: Can I convert several files at once?
faq.a: For conversions that combine files, such as merging PDFs, you can upload up to 20 at a time.

faq.q: Does a scanned PDF become editable?
faq.a: Not directly: a scan is made of images. Extract the text first with the OCR tool, then work on the resulting text.

faq.q: What is the maximum file size?
faq.a: Up to 50 MB per file. If your file is larger, try shrinking or splitting it before converting.

pdf_summary.about: The AI PDF summarizer reads a document and produces a summary with the key points in a few seconds. It helps you get your bearings in a long report, a contract, a research paper or lecture notes before deciding whether to read the whole thing.
steps: Upload a PDF, a Word document (.docx or .doc), a text file or an HTML page.
Start the analysis and wait a few seconds.
Read the summary and key points: you can copy it or send it to another Lab tool.
pdf_summary.privacy: The content of the document is sent to an artificial intelligence service to generate the summary. Do not upload documents you do not want to share with an outside service, such as ones containing personal or confidential data.
pdf_summary.limits: Files up to 20 MB are accepted. If the document is very long only the first part is processed and the tool tells you so. An automatic summary can omit details or contain inaccuracies: for important decisions check the original text. A scanned PDF must go through OCR first. To keep costs under control there is a daily usage limit.

faq.q: Which files can I summarize?
faq.a: PDF, Word (.docx and .doc), text files and HTML, up to 20 MB.

faq.q: Is the summary reliable?
faq.a: It is a good starting point for understanding what a document is about, but an AI can make mistakes or leave out details. Always check the important parts against the original document.

faq.q: Does it work with scanned PDFs?
faq.a: Only if they contain text. If the pages are images, extract the text with the OCR tool and then summarize it.

faq.q: Can I summarize a very long document?
faq.a: The first part is read and the tool warns you that the rest is not included. For very long texts it is best to split the document into parts.

pdf_translate.about: The AI PDF translator translates a document into another language while trying to keep the same number of pages and the same dimensions as the original, page by page. It is meant for contracts, manuals, reports and lecture notes that you need to read or share in another language without rebuilding the document by hand.
steps: Upload a PDF, a Word file (DOCX) or a text file.
Choose the target language and the mode: “high fidelity” keeps the number and size of pages, “standard” is faster and gives clean text.
Start the translation: the tool translates block by block and rebuilds the document.
Download the translated file or send it to another Lab tool.
pdf_translate.privacy: The content of the document is sent to an artificial intelligence service to be translated. Avoid uploading confidential documents or ones with personal data that you do not want to share with an outside service.
pdf_translate.limits: The limit is 50 MB per file. The layout is rebuilt with the same pages and dimensions, but the original fonts and images are not reproduced. If the PDF is made of images the tool detects it and uses OCR, with results that depend on scan quality. For very long documents only the first part may be translated, and the tool tells you so.

faq.q: Does the translated PDF keep the formatting?
faq.a: It keeps the number and size of pages and tries to fit the text into the available space, but it does not reproduce the original fonts and images. For a final check, compare it with the original.

faq.q: Which languages can I translate into?
faq.a: English, Italian, Albanian, Spanish, German, French and more.

faq.q: Does it work with scanned PDFs?
faq.a: Yes: if the PDF is made of images, the tool recognises it and runs OCR first. Quality depends on how sharp the scan is.

faq.q: Is the translation as accurate as a human translator's?
faq.a: No: it is machine translation, great for understanding and working, but for contracts or legal texts review by a professional is still recommended.

ai_ppt.about: The AI presentation generator builds the structure of a presentation from a topic: slide titles, bullet points, speaker notes and a logical thread to follow. It helps you get past the blank page and have a draft to refine within seconds.
steps: Write the topic of the presentation in one sentence.
Choose the style (business, education, minimal, modern or pitch deck) and the number of slides: 5, 10, 15 or 20.
If you like, upload a PDF, a DOCX or a TXT as starting material: the AI uses it as context.
Generate the presentation, read it and download it.
ai_ppt.privacy: The topic and any context document are sent to an artificial intelligence service to generate the slides. Do not enter confidential data that you do not want to share.
ai_ppt.limits: The context document can be up to 20 MB (PDF, DOCX or TXT). The result is a draft: titles, points and notes need checking, adapting and enriching with your own images and data. If the content of some slides is too long it may be shortened: in that case shorten the topic and generate again.

faq.q: How many slides can I generate?
faq.a: 5, 10, 15 or 20, depending on how in-depth the presentation should be.

faq.q: Can I start from my own document?
faq.a: Yes: upload a PDF, a DOCX or a TXT and the AI uses it as context to build the slides.

faq.q: Are the generated slides ready to present?
faq.a: They are a good draft with structure, bullet points and speaker notes, but you should review them and add images, charts and specific data before presenting.

faq.q: Which styles are available?
faq.a: Business, Education, Minimal, Modern and Pitch Deck for startups.

ai_formatter.about: The AI text formatter turns rough notes, meeting minutes or AI-generated text into a tidy document with headings, lists and paragraphs. Use it when you already have the content but do not want to spend time laying it out.
steps: Paste the text into the box or drag in a .txt or .md file.
Start formatting: the AI recognises headings, bullet points and paragraphs.
Switch between the formatted preview and the raw Markdown output.
Copy the result or send it to the editor to export it as PDF or DOCX.
ai_formatter.privacy: The text is sent to an artificial intelligence service to be formatted. Do not paste confidential information that you do not want to share with an outside service. If you reload the page, your draft is restored in the browser.
ai_formatter.limits: At least 10 characters of text are required and .txt and .md files are supported. If the text is very long only the first part is formatted and the tool tells you so. The AI tries to preserve the content, but you should reread the result before using it.

faq.q: What kinds of documents can I create?
faq.a: Proposals, reports, meeting minutes, CVs and articles: the tool adapts the style to the type of text.

faq.q: What format do I get the result in?
faq.a: As a formatted preview or as Markdown, which you can copy and paste wherever you like.

faq.q: Can I use text written by another AI?
faq.a: Yes, it is also meant for tidying text generated by other AI tools, which often arrives without a clear structure.

faq.q: How do I get a PDF or a Word file?
faq.a: Send the formatted text to the Lab's document editor, which exports it to PDF, DOCX or HTML.

pdf_to_word.about: This tool turns a PDF into a Word (DOCX) document you can edit: text, headings, paragraphs and lists become editable again without retyping anything. Use it when you receive a contract, a form or a report as a PDF and need to correct it, complete it or reuse its content.
steps: Click “Convert PDF to Word” and upload the PDF file.
Start the conversion and wait a few seconds.
Download the Word document and open it in Word or another word processor.
pdf_to_word.privacy: To convert the file it is sent to our server, which processes it and returns the result. The file is used only to run the conversion you requested.
pdf_to_word.limits: The file can be up to 50 MB. PDFs with selectable text usually keep headings, paragraphs and lists, but very complex tables and layouts may need small touch-ups in Word. A scanned PDF is made of images and does not become editable text: extract the text first with the OCR tool.

faq.q: Is the formatting preserved?
faq.a: With PDFs that contain selectable text, headings, paragraphs and lists are usually preserved well. Very elaborate layouts, complex tables or multiple columns may need some touch-ups after conversion.

faq.q: Can I convert a scanned PDF?
faq.a: Not directly: a scan is a set of images. Extract the text first with the OCR tool, then work on the resulting text.

faq.q: Do I need to install anything?
faq.a: No, the conversion happens online in any browser. To edit the result you need Word or another program that supports the DOCX format.

word_to_pdf.about: This tool turns a Word document (DOC or DOCX) into a PDF: the ideal format for sharing, sending or printing a file without the layout changing on the recipient's computer. It is useful for CVs, contracts, letters and reports.
steps: Click “Convert Word to PDF” and upload the DOC or DOCX document.
Start the conversion and wait a few seconds.
Download the PDF and share or print it.
word_to_pdf.privacy: To convert the file it is sent to our server, which processes it and returns the result. The file is used only to run the conversion you requested.
word_to_pdf.limits: .doc and .docx files up to 50 MB are accepted. The result depends on the source document: check the PDF before sending it, especially if it contains tables, images or unusual fonts.

faq.q: Which Word formats are accepted?
faq.a: Both .docx files and the older .doc, up to 50 MB.

faq.q: Will the PDF layout match the Word document?
faq.a: Usually yes, but the result depends on the document: with tables, images or unusual fonts it is worth checking the PDF before sharing it.

faq.q: Can I merge several PDFs after converting them?
faq.a: Yes: you can merge them with the “Merge PDF” page, which works right in your browser.

jpg_to_pdf.about: This tool turns one or more images (JPG, PNG or WEBP) into a single PDF. It is useful for sending photos of documents, receipts or notes as one tidy file, or for creating a PDF from a series of shots.
steps: Click “Convert images to PDF” and upload one or more images.
Start the conversion and wait a few seconds.
Download the resulting PDF.
jpg_to_pdf.privacy: Images are sent to our server to create the PDF and are used only for this operation.
jpg_to_pdf.limits: PNG, JPG and WEBP images are accepted, up to 50 MB each and up to 20 files at a time, which end up in a single PDF. To get text you can copy, use the OCR tool afterwards.

faq.q: Can I put several images in one PDF?
faq.a: Yes, you can upload up to 20 images together and get a single PDF.

faq.q: Which image formats are accepted?
faq.a: JPG (JPEG), PNG and WEBP.

faq.q: Will the PDF text be selectable?
faq.a: As a rule the PDF contains the images of the pages, not selectable text. To extract the text use the OCR tool.

merge_pdf.about: With this tool you combine two or more PDFs into a single document, without installing any software. You can reorder the pages by dragging them and delete the ones you do not need before downloading the final file. Use it to bring contracts, forms, receipts or chapters together in one PDF.
steps: Drag the PDFs into the upload area, or click it to choose them: if you pick more than one they are placed in sequence.
In the preview, drag pages to change their order, rotate or delete the ones you do not need.
Export the PDF and download it.
merge_pdf.privacy: Files are processed entirely in your browser: they are not uploaded to any server. You can work on confidential documents without sharing them with third parties.
merge_pdf.limits: Changes are not saved: if you reload or close the tab you lose them, so download the result before leaving. A password-protected or very large PDF may not open or may slow down the browser, because your device does the work.

faq.q: How do I merge two PDFs?
faq.a: Upload both files together: they appear in sequence and you can reorder the pages by dragging them. Then export the result as a single PDF.

faq.q: Are my PDFs uploaded online?
faq.a: No. Merging happens in your browser, so the files stay on your device.

faq.q: Can I merge only some pages of a PDF?
faq.a: Yes: delete the pages you do not need before exporting.

split_pdf.about: This tool lets you split a PDF and extract only the pages you need: you delete the extra ones or use a page range, and download the new PDF. It is useful for sending a single chapter, a form taken from a long document or only the signed pages.
steps: Upload the PDF by dragging it into the upload area.
In the preview delete the pages you do not want, or use the page range to split the document.
Export the PDF and download it: you get a new file with only the pages you chose.
split_pdf.privacy: Files are processed entirely in your browser: they are not uploaded to any server. You can work on confidential documents without sharing them with third parties.
split_pdf.limits: Changes are not saved: if you reload or close the tab you lose them, so download the result before leaving. A password-protected or very large PDF may not open or may slow down the browser, because your device does the work.

faq.q: How do I extract a single page from a PDF?
faq.a: Upload the PDF, delete every page except the one you need and export the result.

faq.q: Is the original PDF modified?
faq.a: No: you work in the browser and download a new PDF, while the source file stays as it is on your device.

faq.q: Is the file uploaded to a server?
faq.a: No. Processing happens in your browser, so the file never leaves your device.

rotate_pdf.about: This tool rotates the pages of a PDF right in your browser: you can straighten a page that was scanned upside down, fix only the crooked ones and leave the others as they were. Then you download the corrected PDF, without installing any software.
steps: Upload the PDF by dragging it into the upload area.
In the preview rotate the individual pages that are crooked or upside down.
Export the PDF and download it.
rotate_pdf.privacy: Files are processed entirely in your browser: they are not uploaded to any server. You can work on confidential documents without sharing them with third parties.
rotate_pdf.limits: Rotation changes the orientation of the pages, not their content. Changes are not saved: if you reload or close the tab you lose them, so download the result before leaving.

faq.q: Can I rotate only some pages?
faq.a: Yes: in the preview you rotate individual pages, and the ones you do not touch stay as they are.

faq.q: Is the PDF uploaded online?
faq.a: No. Processing happens in your browser, so the file stays on your device.

faq.q: Does it work with a PDF that was scanned upside down?
faq.a: Yes: rotate the upside-down pages and export the corrected PDF.

image_to_text.about: This tool turns a photo, a screenshot or a scanned page into text you can select, copy and edit, thanks to OCR (optical character recognition). Use it to recover the text from a photographed receipt, a slide or a printed document.
steps: Drag the image (PNG, JPG, WEBP, BMP or TIFF) into the upload area.
Choose the language of the text: with the right one the result is far more accurate.
Start the recognition and copy the resulting text.
image_to_text.privacy: Images are sent to our server only for recognition and are processed in memory, without being stored as an archive. You do not need to create an account.
image_to_text.limits: You can upload up to 30 files or pages at a time; each image can be up to 15 MB. Quality depends on the photo: crooked, blurry or dim text reduces accuracy.

faq.q: How do I copy text from an image?
faq.a: Upload the image, choose the language and start the recognition: the extracted text appears below and you can copy it.

faq.q: Does it also work with screenshots?
faq.a: Yes, with screenshots, photos of documents and scanned pages, as long as the text is legible.

faq.q: Which languages does it recognise?
faq.a: Italian, English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese and Albanian.

sign_pdf.about: The online PDF signing tool lets you sign a contract or form without printing it. Draw your signature with a finger or mouse, type your name in a handwriting style, or upload a photo of your signature, then place it on any page together with text, the date and check marks. The signed PDF is created in your browser.
steps: Open the PDF: drag it into the box or choose it from your device.
Pick a tool — Signature, Text, Date, check mark or cross — and the item appears on the page.
Drag it where you need it; use the handle to resize it and the buttons to duplicate it, repeat it on all pages or delete it.
Press “Download signed PDF”.
sign_pdf.privacy: The PDF and your signature are processed entirely in your browser and are never uploaded. If you tick “Remember on this device”, the signature is stored only in this browser’s local storage, and you can remove it at any time.
sign_pdf.limits: It adds a simple electronic signature — an image of your signature — and it does not produce a qualified or digital signature with legal certification. Password-protected PDFs cannot be opened. Edits are lost if you close the tab before downloading.

faq.q: Is it free?
faq.a: Yes, completely free and with no sign-up.

faq.q: Is my document uploaded anywhere?
faq.a: No. The PDF and the signature are processed in your browser and never leave your device.

faq.q: Is the signature legally valid?
faq.a: It is a simple electronic signature, accepted for many everyday documents, but it is not a qualified or digital signature. For documents that require one, use a certified provider.

faq.q: Can I sign from my phone?
faq.a: Yes. You can draw your signature with your finger, then drag and resize it on the page.

faq.q: Can I put my signature on every page?
faq.a: Yes: select the signature and choose “On all pages”.

compress_pdf.about: The online PDF compressor reduces the size of a PDF so you can send it by email or upload it to a form with a size limit. You choose between redrawing the pages at a lower resolution — much smaller, ideal for scans — or only tidying the file structure so the text stays selectable. You see the size before and after, and the file is processed in your browser.
steps: Open the PDF: drag it into the box or choose it from your device.
Pick how to compress: “Smaller file” (pages as images) or “Keep the text”.
If you chose pages as images, set the level: Light, Medium or Strong.
Press “Compress PDF”, check the size before and after, then download.
compress_pdf.privacy: The PDF is processed entirely in your browser and is never uploaded. Nothing is stored after you close the page.
compress_pdf.limits: “Smaller file” turns each page into an image, so the text can no longer be selected or searched — use “Keep the text” if you need it, accepting a smaller saving. PDFs with more than 400 pages or protected by a password are not supported. If the result is not noticeably smaller, the tool tells you so and you can keep the original.

faq.q: How much smaller will my PDF be?
faq.a: It depends on the content. Scans and photos often shrink by 70–90%; text documents save little unless you accept turning pages into images.

faq.q: Is my file uploaded anywhere?
faq.a: No. The PDF is compressed in your browser and never leaves your device.

faq.q: Why can’t I select the text after compressing?
faq.a: In “Smaller file” mode each page is redrawn as an image. Choose “Keep the text” to preserve it.

faq.q: Is it free?
faq.a: Yes, free and with no sign-up.

image_tools.about: This tool converts photos between JPG, PNG and WebP, turns iPhone HEIC photos into JPG, and shrinks images by resizing them and lowering the quality. You can process up to 40 images at once and download them together as a ZIP. Everything happens in your browser, and the location and other hidden data of each photo are removed from the new file.
steps: Drop your photos in the box or choose them from your device (HEIC, JPG, PNG, WebP…).
Pick the format, the longest side (for example 1920 px for the web or email) and, for JPG and WebP, the quality.
Press “Convert” and check the size before and after for each image.
Download the files one by one or all together as a ZIP.
image_tools.privacy: The images are processed entirely in your browser and are never uploaded. The new files have no GPS position, camera data or other metadata.
image_tools.limits: The first time you open a HEIC file the browser downloads a small decoder, which can take a few seconds (Safari opens HEIC directly). Photos above about 64 megapixels are skipped, and the limit is 40 files of up to 60 MB each. Converting a lossy image again always loses a little quality, so keep your originals.

faq.q: How do I convert HEIC to JPG?
faq.a: Drop the HEIC photos here, leave the format on JPG and press Convert. You can download them one by one or as a ZIP.

faq.q: Are my photos uploaded anywhere?
faq.a: No. They are converted in your browser and never leave your device.

faq.q: Is the GPS location removed?
faq.a: Yes. The new files are created from the image pixels only, so location, camera model and other metadata are not copied.

faq.q: What size should I choose for email or the web?
faq.a: A longest side of 1920 px with 80–85% quality is a good balance. Use 1280 px or less for small previews.

faq.q: Is it free?
faq.a: Yes, free and with no sign-up.

qr_code.about: The QR code generator turns a link, text, Wi‑Fi network, contact card, email, phone number or WhatsApp message into a QR code that any phone camera can read. Choose the colours and the size and download the code as a PNG image or as a scalable SVG for printing. The code is created in your browser from what you type.
steps: Pick the type of code: Link, Text, Wi‑Fi, Contact, Email, Phone or WhatsApp.
Fill in the details: the code appears on the right as you type.
Open “Options” to change error correction, margin, size and colours.
Scan it with your phone to check it, then download the PNG or SVG.
qr_code.privacy: Everything you type is turned into a code in your browser and is never sent to a server. There is no tracking of the content, and no sign-up.
qr_code.limits: A QR code can hold only a limited amount of text (a few thousand characters); longer content is refused. Codes are static: they cannot be edited or counted after printing, and they never expire. Keep a dark code on a light background with enough contrast, or some scanners will not read it.

faq.q: Is it free and without a watermark?
faq.a: Yes. The codes are free, have no watermark and never expire.

faq.q: Is what I type sent anywhere?
faq.a: No. The code is generated in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

faq.q: Should I download PNG or SVG?
faq.a: PNG for screens, documents and social media; SVG for printing, because it stays sharp at any size.

faq.q: How do I make a Wi‑Fi QR code?
faq.a: Choose Wi‑Fi, enter the network name and password, and print the code: guests scan it to join without typing the password.

faq.q: Why can’t my phone read the code?
faq.a: Usually because of low contrast, inverted colours, or a printed size that is too small. Use a dark code on a light background and at least 2 cm wide.

heic_to_jpg.about: iPhones save photos in HEIC, a format that Windows, many websites and older apps cannot open. This tool converts HEIC and HEIF files to JPG or PNG directly in your browser, keeping the quality you choose and offering a ZIP download for many photos at once.
steps: Drag your HEIC photos into the upload area, or click it to choose them.
Check that the format is JPG and pick the quality you prefer.
Convert and download each photo, or all of them as a single ZIP.
heic_to_jpg.privacy: Photos are processed entirely in your browser: they are not uploaded to any server and nobody else can see them.
heic_to_jpg.limits: Very large photos or many files at once can slow down a phone, because your device does the work. Work in small batches if needed.

faq.q: How do I open HEIC photos on Windows?
faq.a: Convert them to JPG with this tool: it works in the browser, with no software to install.

faq.q: Do my photos get uploaded?
faq.a: No. The conversion happens on your device, so the photos never leave it.
